name: Foliage Outdoors Kolad
why_special: Adventure-tourism camp by the Kundalika river — A/C and non-A/C luxury tents, river-rafting operator with rapids Class II–III on the dam-release schedule. The Kolad-rafting weekend base for Mumbai/Pune groups.

name: Kundalika Riverside Resort
why_special: Private mid-range resort on the Kundalika river bank — 25 cottages, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant. The polished alternative to tent camps for families that want rafting access without sleeping under canvas.
